newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGE sells Financiere Moncey stake.
newsitem.headline: CGE sells Financiere Moncey stake.

text.p: The French Rivaud group said in a statement on Wednesday that it had bought the 10 percent stake in Financiere Moncey held by utilities group Cie Generale des Eaux (CGE).
A Rivaud spokesman said the purchase was made at close to the stock's market price. Shares in holding company Financiere Moncey traded at 2,990 francs at 1124 GMT.
The purchase was made through Plantation des Terres Rouges and is part of Rivaud's plan to simplify its structure.
The main assets of Financiere Moncey, part of the vast Rivaud constellation of companies, include stakes in Air Liberte, Elitair and Intertechnique.
British Airways Plc's TAT French subsidiary bought Air Liberte last year when the airline went bankrupt.
Financiere Moncey is controlled by three holdings in the Rivaud group, Tramways Var-Gard, Mines de Kali Sainte-Therese and Financiere de l'Artois.

Last November, another Rivaud firm, Compagnie du Cambodge, which is controlled by Plantation des Terres Rouges and in turn controls Mines de Kali, launched a takeover bid for Mines de Kali and Caoutchoucs de Padang, as part of the drive to clarify the group structure.
Financiere Moncey bought seven percent of Financiere de l'Artois three weeks ago from a private investor.
